[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 58[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6327870][color=#ffffff]$2k July Contest[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Now in the last week of the $2k July contest it has been great to see the boost in activity and all the members getting involved. There are still plenty of days left to take part, members can earn entries by posting and creating threads round the forum, with [mention=1] suggesting more threads than posts. With that in mind will you be participating for the first time? Posting to gain more entries? Have a good thread? Now is the time to get active and posting. For more information on the contest or to post your appreciation please check out the original contest thread and good luck to everyone taking part.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]Don't Forget to Live[/size][/b][/color]
It's easy to get caught in the cycle of responsibilities—work, bills, deadlines, and endless to-do lists. Many people spend so much time preparing for the future that they forget to enjoy the present. But life isn't only about reaching goals; it's also about the moments in between.
Take time to laugh with friends, enjoy a hobby, watch a sunset, travel somewhere new, or simply appreciate a quiet evening. These moments may seem small, but they are often the memories that stay with us the longest.
Success has little meaning if you never slow down enough to enjoy it.
[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]
Make time for what makes you feel alive, not just what keeps you busy.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]  
“Life is what happens while you are busy making other plans.”
— John Lennon

[u][b][size=large]God of War Laufey Announced[/size][/b][/u]

Sony and Santa Monica studio have revealed that God of War Laufey is set for a February 2027 release window.

[u][b][size=large]PlayStation Network Downage[/size][/b][/u]

An unexpected PSN outage earlier this week left thousands of players unable to login, access there online libraries or play online games.

[u][b][size=large]Batman: Caped Crusader Chronicles[/size][/b][/u]

Batman Caped Crusader Chronicles is an 11 episode interactive detective adventure, set to release on July 31 via Amazon Luna’s GameNight collection.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6328397]+++ Mastercarder's MASSIVE 10,000 bytes giveaway +++[/url] By [mention=4746120] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

A new bytes giveaway has arrived by the member known as [mention=4746120] They are giving away 10,000 bytes to one lucky winner. The requirements are very simple, asking you to answer one of the questions in the contest thread. The giveaway ends on the 29th of July 2026, and you can all get a chance to enter. Good luck!

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6328649][GIVEAWAY]$10 in ETH to one lucky member[/url] By [mention=5751676] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

Are you feeling lucky? Got the itch to win some free ETH? Well, look no more, here we have a giveaway just for you. The winner will be picked at random on the 30th of July 2026, and you just need to follow the contest's rules. You may only enter once, but that means every person has the same odds of winning, so you could be the lucky winner.
